card.name: Linking words before pressure or volume terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "in" and "total" right after a noun like reduction, increase, shift or depletion. The next word is a body-fluid or chemical term such as intracranial pressure, potassium, vascular volume or dissolved solids.

modes.label: Change nouns plus of/in
modes.description: "of" or "in" after reduction, increase, shift or depletion, before a physiological quantity.
modes.example: cause a shift<< in>> potassium from the extracellular to intracellular

modes.label: Start of a word like intracranial
modes.description: The opening piece of intracranial right after "Reduction of".
modes.example: Reduction of<< Intr>>acranial Pressure and Treatment of C

modes.label: Soil or water chemistry
modes.description: "of" or "total" in soil and water chemistry text, before phosphorus or dissolved solids.
